implementation_notes: Column ordinals are reference order only; actual CSV headers bind by exact header names, never by a guessed position.
Identity columns above are explicit source-qualified adapter keys; original opaque values are preserved without trimming or case conversion.
Raw CSV rows and original bytes remain retained. Repeated clients/episodes may collapse only when all projected values agree; every contributing record stays in the lineage.
All 290 headers remain in an NDTMS extract, including non-applicable blank fields. This catalogue is distinct from an obtained supplier import schema.
The layout column is preserved verbatim. Reference-code exceptions and trigger dates must be applied from their actual source rather than inferred from the A/C/N notation.
Consent is episode-specific. The no-consent extraction row contains only AGNCY, CLIENTID, EPISODID and CONSENT.
Published technical rules are a source-qualified reference; this table alone is not the complete clinical submission validation service.
Inclusion labels TOP and YPOR refer to the outcomes-profile family; adult versus young-person cohort selection remains explicit.
